Callout.Name: Bank Siege
Callout.Message: Armed robbery turned siege, staff inside with the suspects.
Callout.Advisory: Two males, weapons seen, no shots fired.

Script.Line: We are not opening the door.
Nobody has been hurt. We do not want anybody hurt.
We want a way out of here and we want it in writing.
We are sending somebody out. Do not shoot.

Stages.Stage: The door is opening - hands first.
Both in custody. Tally the staff and let them go.

Lines.Briefing: A siege is a conversation with a clock on it. Keep them talking.
Lines.Approach: Two of them and staff in there. Do not go in - establish contact and keep them talking.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
